description: This file defines a custom exception class named MultiDisbursementEmiAmountException, used in the loan scheduling component of the Fineract project to handle specific validation errors related to EMI amounts during multiple disbursements.

classes.name: MultiDisbursementEmiAmountException
classes.description: A custom exception class extending AbstractPlatformDomainRuleException to indicate errors where EMI amounts must be greater than interest during multiple disbursements.

methods.name: MultiDisbursementEmiAmountException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a specific error message key and optional arguments for message formatting.
